Subject: Post-demo recap + next steps (NovaBank)

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for your time today — appreciate the thoughtful discussion on NovaBank's realtime risk scoring and payments monitoring use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What we heard: primary need is sub-200ms inference for short-text alerts (2-5 tokens for classification + 128-token context), strict isolation for PII, and auditability for model decisions.
- Success criteria: <=200ms p95 end-to-end, SOC2-compatible audit logs, and < $0.0008/token operational cost target at 100 TPS.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share a one-page architecture & proposal + cost estimate (attached).
2) Recommend a short lab/proof-of-concept (2 weeks) to validate latency and KV cache behavior; SE can stand up a private instance.
3) If that looks good, we can sketch a timeline for Reserved Dedicated capacity and sign a short pilot agreement.

Attachments: 20261102-novabank-proposal.pdf (proposal + cost estimate), redwood-arch-diagram.png (high-level deployment options).

Are you available next Tuesday or Wednesday for a 30-min follow-up to align on the POC scope? If neither works, tell me preferred timing and we'll adapt.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
